active.title: Project pages that show how rand-engine and dadaia-workspace work
active.description: Operator words on the rand-engine page: "it's poor, it lacks diagrams that are representatives. It lacks animated GIFs presenting some dynamics and functionality"; "Think about users seeing … GIFs that are very representative about how the lib works". Rulings: projects first ("Projects first"), as the next candidate. (1) A shared base for the whole site: the header on every page with Resume · Projects · Blog plus theme and language controls; one type scale; no nested boxes or section accordions in shared parts; hardcoded Portuguese strings and the document language follow the selected locale. (2) The rand-engine and dadaia-workspace pages rebuilt in one order: what it is + install line, a ~10 s hero loop, how it works in moving scenes, a real copyable example, why it exists, a facts table where every number names its source at a pinned tag. rand-engine scenes: spec → DataFrame (hero), related tables PK/FK, event stream, files written in parts. dadaia-workspace scenes: one command → workspace + doctor (hero), demand → merge flow, the gate refuses, one law → six harnesses; the page states only what the PyPI version on recording day ships. (3) The games project and Portfolio Architecture move onto the new template unchanged ("Keep, restyled only"). (4) Every scene legible at 360px; recordings ship as muted looping video with a poster, diagrams as animated SVG, reduced motion shows the still; recordings are scripted so a new library version is one re-record; asset file names are versioned (assets are cached immutable for a year). (5) The definition carries a static mockup for operator approval. (6) False or unsourced claims on the current pages are fixed in scope — rand-engine: version 0.6.4 vs PyPI 0.8.0, DuckDB, `.generate()`, partitioned export, unsourced rows/s and test counts; dadaia-workspace: four-role diagrams, `context activate`, a PyPI version not yet published.

active.title: A lighter, better-organized resume home
active.description: Operator words: "I like minimalism"; "The frames that a person reading it views are not good. Many information. It's a bit not organized."; "I don't want a huge change here. But we need to do a refinement … about position of topics inside the website". Rulings: the home stays the resume, refined ("Home = resume, refined"); section order Hero → Experience → Projects (2–3 featured) → Skills → Certifications → Education ("After Experience"); the three pre-data roles (Adjunct Instructor 2015–18, Laboratory Assistant UFOP 2016–17, Summer Internship Analógica 2015) collapse into one "Earlier" line ("Collapse into one line"); Skills and Certifications become compact lists; the hero "$ now" panel is removed; the hero stat "4 clouds" is corrected (Skills lists three cloud providers); the compact hero headline of the 2026-06-11 operator ruling is kept. Target: the candidate after library-pages-in-motion, on its shared base.

active.title: A personal blog
active.description: Operator words: "I also want another session called blog. Where I'll write some articles."; "We need 3 parts, we have my resume, we have my personal projects, and we will have my personal blog". Rulings: posts are Markdown in this repo, one folder per post (text, images, moving images); the build writes real HTML per post and per project page with title, description and share image, plus an RSS feed ("Markdown in repo, static HTML"); one language per post, chosen by the author, listed in every locale with a language tag ("One per post, your choice"); v1 = index, post page, tags, RSS; the Blog nav item appears once the first post exists. Target: the candidate after resume-refinement.
